#639 · Cavern Pokémon

Terrakion

Rock Fighting

Unova · Generation 5 · Legendary Pokémon

Terrakion is a Rock/Fighting-type Cavern Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.9 m tall and weighs 260 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (129), with a base stat total of 580.
